integrity: Proof includes exact component counting, a complete sign classification, and large-network asymptotics. The independent finite graph enumeration checks symbolic identities for six values of the branching size but is not used to prove the infinite-family theorem.
scientific_limitations: Exact analytic classification is restricted to identical two-hub double-star trees, exactly two simultaneous seeds, homogeneous independent edge transmissibility, and deterministic one-step recovery; no extension to other graphs or longer infectious periods is asserted. Priority remains subject to independent checking for equivalent earlier influence-maximization or finite-tree percolation results.
title: A sharp bridge-bottleneck boundary for two-seed SIR switchover on double stars
